notes.title: Red Spider:Vengeance Remastered Is Out!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45648571/a50d8f1b46cccb596091cde02d70ba339786a852.jpg"][/img]To all our series fans,[/p][p]Thank you for your patience! We're excited to announce that Red Spider:Vengeance Remastered, the remastered version of first title in the series, is officially released today, September 15th.[/p][p]We've completely overhauled the graphics, re-recorded some of the voices, and made detailed revisions to the text and the "CYCLOPEDIA" feature. We've put a lot of work into this to give you a deeper and more immersive experience.[/p][p]The game's full story is completely free to play. We invite you to dive into the world of the new Red Spider![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Releasing Tomorrow!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45648571/641b5c4280827a1541dcf57e540ca2438c993116.jpg"][/img]Our game will be released tomorrow, on [b]Monday, September 15th.[/b][/p][p]You can play the entire story for free in the [b]Demo version[/b]. [/p][p]If you would like to unlock Steam Achievements and support the game's development, please purchase the [b]Donation Edition[/b].[/p]

notes.title: Request for Cantonese Translation Feedback
notes.notes:
[p]Our Hong Kong noir-style visual novel, "Red Spider:Vengeance Remastered", is now available in Early Access! 🌃[/p][p]To provide the most authentic experience, the Traditional Chinese version of the game's dialogue uses extensive Hong Kong colloquialisms.[/p][p]We are a Japanese team, so we sincerely invite native Cantonese-speaking players to help check if the translation feels natural and offer your feedback, so that we can make the game even better![/p][p]For details and how to provide feedback, please see the devlog:
[url="https://studiowasp.itch.io/red-spider-vengeance-remastered/devlog/1009556/early-access-release-request-for-translation-feedback"]https://studiowasp.itch.io/red-spider-vengeance-remastered/devlog/1009556/early-access-release-request-for-translation-feedback[/url][/p]
